title: Something Wrong With the Apartment
summaryZh: 房客向房東反映熱水故障和牆面滲水，兩人協調水電工上門的時間。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Hi, it's Ellen up in 4B, and I'm calling about the hot water going out again.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是四樓 B 室的 Ellen，我打來是因為熱水又停了。
sentences.note: it's Ellen 的 /s/ 直接連到 Ellen 的母音，聽起來像 /ɪ.ˈtsɛ.lən/。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: I thought that plumber sorted the whole thing out when he came by a couple of weeks ago.
sentences.zh: 我以為那個水電工兩個禮拜前來的時候就把問題解決了。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: So did I, but it started acting up on Sunday and now it's completely cold.
sentences.zh: 我也這麼以為，可是它星期天開始出狀況，現在完全是冷的。
sentences.note: started acting 兩字的 t 和 d 都在母音間變閃音，連成 /ˈstɑɹ.ɾɪ.ˈɾæk.tɪŋ/。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Alright, is the kitchen sink running cold as well, or is it just the shower?
sentences.zh: 好，那廚房水槽也是冷的嗎，還是只有淋浴間？

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Everything is cold, and there's a damp patch on the wall behind the water heater.
sentences.zh: 全部都是冷的，而且熱水器後面的牆上有一塊濕掉的地方。
sentences.note: there's a 連讀成 /ðɛɹ.zə/；behind the 的 d 碰到 th 幾乎消失。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: A damp patch behind the heater doesn't sound good, so I'd better get someone out there.
sentences.zh: 熱水器後面會濕聽起來就不太妙，我最好找人過去看看。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: I was hoping you'd say that, because I've been boiling water on the stove for three days.
sentences.zh: 我就等你這句話，因為我已經在瓦斯爐上燒了三天的熱水。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: I can't get a plumber in until Thursday, unless you're around during the day tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我最快也要星期四才找得到水電工，除非你明天白天在家。
sentences.note: can't 的 t 通常不爆破，要靠母音變短和鼻音來判斷是否定句。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: I can move some things around and work from home, as long as he shows up before noon.
sentences.zh: 我可以調整一下行程在家工作，只要他中午前到就好。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: I'll ask him to come first thing, and I'll text you once he confirms the time.
sentences.zh: 我會請他一早就過去，他確認時間之後我再傳訊息給你。
sentences.note: first thing 的 t 被後面的 th 吃掉；ask him 的 h 脫落，連成 /ˈæs.kɪm/。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: While I've got you, would you knock something off this month's rent for the trouble?
sentences.zh: 既然講到了，這個月的房租能不能因為這些麻煩少算一點？

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Let's see what the plumber says first, and then we can work something out on the rent.
sentences.zh: 先聽聽水電工怎麼說，房租的部分我們再想辦法。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: That's fair, but please don't leave me hanging like last time when nobody called back.
sentences.zh: 這樣算合理，但拜託別像上次那樣把我晾著，都沒人回電。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: You've got my word on it, and I'll follow up myself if he doesn't turn up.
sentences.zh: 我跟你保證，如果他沒出現我會自己去追。
sentences.note: got my 的 t 不發出來，變成喉塞音 /ɡɑʔ.maɪ/。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Thanks, I'll be here from eight tomorrow, so just send him up whenever he gets in.
sentences.zh: 謝謝，我明天八點就會在，他到了就直接讓他上來。

questions.q: What is the tenant calling about?
options: No hot water and a damp wall

questions.q: Why does the tenant agree to stay home tomorrow?
options: So she doesn't have to wait until Thursday

questions.q: What does the landlord say about the rent?
options: He will decide after the plumber has been
He already reduced it last month
